title: Serialize planning writes
responsibility: Queue planning work per repository, guard artifact cleanliness and commit only the prepared files.

inputs.name: planWrite.git
inputs.description: Repository handle whose dir keys the in-process queue, so calls for the same dir run one after another, and is where planWrite creates the harness-planning.lock directory. planWrite sets transactionHead to the revision read after the lock is taken; a lock directory that already exists, or cannot be created, makes the call reject through fail('repository-busy', ...).

inputs.name: planWrite.work
inputs.description: Callback that runs once the lock is taken and transactionHead is set; planWrite resolves with its value or rejects with its error, and the lock is removed after it settles. It is not called when the lock is not acquired or revision(git) fails.

inputs.name: clean.git
inputs.description: Repository handle passed to safePath for unitPath and to assertClean, which uses it for the artifact-path checks.

inputs.name: clean.unitPath
inputs.description: Repository-relative plan folder path; clean passes it to safePath, then builds the plan.json, designs, threads and .gitattributes paths beneath it by template strings without normalizing it.

inputs.name: assertClean.git
inputs.description: Repository handle used by safePath for each artifact path and by git.run for the git status command.

inputs.name: assertClean.artifactPaths
inputs.description: Repository-relative paths that assertClean checks with safePath and passes as pathspecs to git status --porcelain --untracked-files=all --ignored. Any status output rejects through fail('artifact-dirty', ...), and an empty array adds no pathspec, so the status check is not limited to these paths.

inputs.name: commitFiles.git
inputs.description: Repository handle used for the revision read, the symbolic-ref lookup, the read-tree, write-tree and commit-tree commands, and the stageFiles, planCommit and requireLfsFilters calls (requireLfsFilters only when a path ends in .png). commitFiles rejects through fail('conflict', ...) unless the current revision equals git.transactionHead, which planWrite sets.

inputs.name: commitFiles.files
inputs.description: Map from repository-relative paths to file contents, where each value is text (string) or bytes (Uint8Array); the map is passed to stageFiles and planCommit, its keys are returned as paths, and any key ending in .png runs requireLfsFilters before the commit is built.

inputs.name: commitFiles.message
inputs.description: Commit message passed unchanged to git commit-tree with -m; this code neither trims nor validates it.

outputs.name: planWrite
outputs.description: Value resolved by work, returned only after the lock is removed in a finally block that also runs when work rejects.

outputs.name: clean
outputs.description: Resolves with no value when safePath accepts the plan folder and assertClean finds no status output for its four artifact paths; otherwise it rejects.

outputs.name: assertClean
outputs.description: Resolves with no value when safePath accepts every artifact path and git status prints nothing for them; otherwise it rejects.

outputs.name: commitFiles
outputs.description: Object with the commit ID from git commit-tree, the parent revision (equal to git.transactionHead), the short name of the checked-out branch and the keys of the files map as paths; it resolves after planCommit completes.

errors.name: PlanningFailure
errors.description: Thrown through fail(...) for repository-busy when the lock directory cannot be created, for artifact-dirty when artifact paths have status output, and for conflict when the current revision differs from git.transactionHead or symbolic-ref returns an empty branch name. Other errors from safePath, requireLfsFilters, Git commands and filesystem calls propagate.
